In particular, balanced-crystalloids' refused registered CI stays absent; its already-served common-effect CI stays unchanged.
fix: Sweep: 32/32 served review pages checked; 4 affected, 28 clean; 26 offending rendered occurrences enumerated above. Add one shared display_measure(result) helper that inspects estmeasure and scale_mixed rather than trusting scale or a precomputed effect_label alone. For these pools return 'mixed HR/RR; FIRST_EVENT_RATIO', using dynamically derived labels/classes. Use it in page._ci, _effect_rows, _common_effect_row, both Estimand rows, and manuscript.render's pooled-result wording. Reuse it for forest-axis fallback and any future pooled-estimate consumer. Keep incompatible/suppressed pools gated. Do not replace the computational scale: GRADE and forest transformations inspect it. No additional single-measure propagation was found in the served Analysis axes, canonical-claim table, GRADE text or comparator panel. Protocol target-scale decisions and individual-trial/source quotations are not pooled-estimate labels. Ticagrelor's mixed major-bleeding pool is suppressed by harms_synthesis_suppressed; corticosteroids-CAP and IV-iron suppress their incompatible pools.
plant: Build a regression fixture by deep-copying the served balanced-crystalloids-vs-saline-mortality primary result, preserving scale='HR', scale_mixed=['HR','RR'], estmeasure.status='compatible_labels', classes=['FIRST_EVENT_RATIO'], estimate=0.9774 and its existing pooled_ci_refused object. Integration coverage should render the four affected objects and assert the shared display label occurs in both Estimand cells, each pooled-value cell and both manuscript result passages, while numerical fields remain deeply equal and refused CIs remain unserved. The fixtures contain copied served data, not invented research results.
